SECTION 2 - IMMUNISATION

Immunisation rates comprise of the following components:

2.1  Immunisation against 20 notifiable Old cases (boosters) are not chargeable.

2.2  Procedure Vaccinations: $20 to $35.

2.3  Vaccines as follows:

    • BCG                                  $20 - $35
    • Diphtheria, Pert (dpt dose)          $80 - $100
    • Cholera                             $20 - $35
    • Measles, Mumps and Rubella          $40 - $55
    • Haemophilus B Virus                 $50 - $70
    • Hepatitis (complete course of 3 injections) $180 - $210
    • Tuberculosis (for children under 15 years)  $60 - $100
    • Tetanus (for children under 15 years)        $20 - $40
    • Typhoid                            $20 - $35
    • Triple Antigen and Polio            $25 - $35
    • Influenza Vaccination               $25 - $35

Note:
    Immunisation rates differ according to brands. Price variations by manufacturers or distributors may also occur from time to time.

S.M.A. Guidelines on Fees - 10


SECTION 3 - MEDICAL EXAMINATIONS

INTRODUCTION
(a)  Medical examinations refer to physical check-ups which are required for licensing, employment or admission purposes.
(b)  The medical examinations listed below check for pregnancy tests, blood and other lab tests which are not chargeable.
